kerry54reed 14m This deserves a little more nuance. Consumer ChatGPT/ChatGPT Health is not HIPAA-eligible for use by HIPAA-covered healthcare entities, but that does not mean there are no privacy protections or that users have no idea how their information is handled. OpenAI publishes its privacy practices. Health conversations and connected medical records are not used to train its foundational models by default, and OpenAI states that it does not sell users’ personal data, including health data. 1
